notes: Bachelor's in Business Studies (BSc) Bachelor's in Business Studies Bachelor of Science in Business Studies Application recommendation for non-EU applicants with visa requirements: To start in the autumn semester: end of May To start in the spring semester: end of September We focus on the quality of teaching. For the Bachelor's in Business study programme at EBS, you need to plan for the following investment . The compulsory courses consist of all essential areas of business administration and economics. Teaching is interdisciplinary and based on the modular-integrative concept. We combine related subjects into networked teaching units (modules), linking methods and theory with specialist applications (integration). In this way, you can quickly recognise the sense and benefit of methods and theories and will acquire knowledge more easily and sustainably. Academic Writing, Effective Communication, and Personal Mastery Bachelor's thesis Business studies with a degree from EBS Universität – you spend five semesters at EBS Universität and one semester abroad. Optionally, the programme can be extended by a seventh semester to increase the ECTS to be earned to 210. You will spend the first part of your studies at EBS Universität and then transfer to one of our partner universities for the second part of your studies. This will give you a Bachelor of Science degree from EBS and a degree from your university abroad. A distinctive feature of the Bachelor in Business Studies at EBS is that you can study according to your interests, goals and talent already in the Bachelor's programme. You decide on a specific focus in the fifth semester. Projects with partners in Germany and abroad Students who choose the international dual degree option spend three semesters at a partner university abroad. In addition to the EBS Bachelor's degree, these students earn the corresponding degree from their partner university. We focus on the quality of teaching. You start your six semesters with a two-week Onboarding Project. In your second year, you will spend at least one semester at one of our 200 partner universities abroad. If you choose the dual degree option, you study for three semesters at EBS and three at a partner university. During the summer months, internships are planned, optionally also abroad. We offer language courses (including country specifics and culture) in preparation for your time abroad.
The programme takes place entirely on-site. Should the situation require it, the courses can also take place in hybrid form in individual cases.
EBS Universität conducts a holistic selection process. We assess your scores in the context of your overall profile, professional experience and background.
There are no application deadlines at EBS; however, early application is particularly recommended for international candidates and scholarship seekers.

To apply as a doctoral student, applicants need to obtain a promise of doctoral supervision by a senior professor of EBS Business School and then apply to the Doctoral Committee via the Office for Doctoral Studies. The Doctoral Committee decides on the admission of new applicants.
Tuition fees per semester in EUR
Internal doctoral candidate: no tuition fees External doctoral candidate: 2,280 EUR per semester
For the most essential elements of the EBS Doctoral Study Programme , see below:
Mandatory courses conveying a theoretical and methodological background, supplemented by specialised electives customised to the different fields of research
Annual proposal defences guarantee regular feedback and involvement of the candidate’s second supervisor in the research process
Obligatory presentation of a competitive paper at an international scientific conference
Courses offered in this year’s Doctoral Summer School
Survey Design and Measurement in Social Science
Research Forum: Developing PhD Research Projects
Fundamentals of Experimental Design and Analysis

The programme consists of two mandatory courses offered every semester and at least four elective courses during the yearly Doctoral Summer School. The teaching language is English. Courses are usually offered as block seminars for two and a half days. Mandatory semi-yearly proposal defences with your supervisors complement the programme to discuss the current state of the doctoral candidate’s research. Besides, at least one presentation has to be given at a worldwide EBS target list conference. Active attendance at three internal research colloquia guarantees constant exchange with other researchers.
A Diploma supplement will be issued

Comprehensive organisation at no extra cost—hotel accommodation and meals are included.

The EBS Talent Camp 2026 offers you the perfect opportunity to make meaningful use of your summer break and prepare for your academic and professional future. In an inspiring environment, you will work on hands-on projects guided by EBS professors and research assistants.

Over the course of our three-day Summer School, you will attend introductory lectures in the fields of business and law and tackle exciting case studies focused on the key topic of Artificial Intelligence. Along the way, you will sharpen your analytical thinking, enhance your presentation skills, and deepen your foundational knowledge in management and legal studies—all within the forward-looking contexts of sustainability and artificial intelligence.

Talks by inspiring guest speakers and a variety of organised leisure activities give you the chance to build your first professional contacts, explore the region, and gain an authentic insight into student life at EBS Universität.

notes: Master's in Business Analytics (MSc) Master's in Business Analytics Master of Science in Business Analytics The programme comprises four semesters (120 ECTS) and can be started each year in the autumn or spring semesters. With the appropriate qualifications, the programme can be shortened to two semesters (accelerated track | 60 ECTS). With an additional semester abroad (dual degree option), you have the opportunity to acquire a double degree. Application recommendation for non-EU applicants with visa requirements: To start in the autumn semester: end of May To start in the spring semester: end of September Combined Master's degree / PhD programme The Master's in Business Analytics programme is divided into different stages. At the beginning of the programme, we will prepare you for your future research work and support you in the further development of your leadership skills. Building on this, you will deal with the essential issues of your field, consolidate newly acquired knowledge and grow as a leader. We have designed the EBS Master's programmes to be flexible, depending on your level of knowledge, skills and goals. Accelerate your career. If you meet the relevant requirements and have already gained experience abroad, you can shorten the Master's programme to two semesters. You can obtain another international degree (MBA or Master's) in addition to your EBS degree. Extend your study abroad at one of our partner universities by one semester and receive a double degree. In this way, you will gain more expertise in a broader international context, and you will increase your global market value. Projects with partners in Germany and abroad Semester Abroad Track (120 ECTS) Practice Track (120 ECTS) Academic admission requirements A Bachelor’s degree and transcripts in any field of study with at least 180 ECTS or an equivalent recognised qualification. A valid GMAT (either classic or new Focus edition – scores will be based on GMAC's percentile tables), GRE, Business Admissions Test (BAT), EBSgrad Test, Common Admissions Test (CAT) If your application documents meet our admission requirements, we will invite you to an individual interview. During this interview, we will assess your motivation and social skills. The decisive factors are your motivation to perform and learn, your social communication profile, your willingness to take on social responsibility, and your initiative. Language requirements TOEFL iBT score min. 95 IELTS min. band score 7 Application recommendation for non-EU applicants with visa requirements: To start in the autumn semester: end of May To start in the spring semester: end of September Nestled in the picturesque town of Oestrich-Winkel near the financial hub of Frankfurt, EBS offers a unique academic experience beyond education; it's your gateway to a world of opportunity and personal growth. With an international focus and a strong network, our Master's programmes are designed to elevate your skills and career prospects.

deadlines: EBS Universität conducts a holistic selection process. We assess your scores in the context of your overall profile, professional experience and background.
fees: Semester Abroad Track | Practice Track: 33,780 EUR in total
